description: Read OpenVibe.Codes' resource index (ADR-048): GET /api/v1/resources lists the resources Codes owns as a page of common.resource-summary@1 (common.resource-list-result@1), and GET /api/v1/resources/:ovrn reads one by its OVRN (common.resource-summary@1). Every authority serves these for OpenVibe.Services to fan out and merge; Codes' own resources are its validated app and mod manifests (kind codes.manifest, id mfs_<ULID>) and its releases (kind codes.release, id rel_<ULID>), each carrying the Network project it was created in as its tenancy boundary. Trust tiers are per-app metadata and playground run logs are audit records, neither a resource; Codes hosts no repositories, so the catalog carries no codes.repo kind. Planned until Codes ships the index.
